DAMAC hands over 50,000 homes, secures new construction awards

Real estate developer DAMAC has announced the handover of 50,000 homes, with an additional 55,000 units currently in the pipeline. The company also reported securing construction awards totaling USD 2.72 billion for the first half of 2026. These figures represent significant milestones in the company's project delivery and future development plans.
